_comment: Byte ceilings for the generated components that ship inside every document (#1250).
tools/build.py enforces these on every build and every --check, so the required
dist-in-sync job fails a pull request that blows one. Raising a ceiling is a deliberate,
reviewed edit here plus a changelog line - that is the whole point of the gate: growth
becomes a decision instead of the 3.5x drift that went unnoticed across earlier versions.
